about.story_text_1: Fashion Comfort Group is an international knitwear manufacturing partner with over 20 years of experience, working with fashion brands that value quality, reliability and responsible production.
about.story_bullet_1_text: Production operations in Bangladesh with direct quality control and our own manufacturing facility
about.story_bullet_2_text: Design, development, sourcing and sales teams across Barcelona, Prato, Shanghai and Tokyo
about.story_bullet_3_text: A manufacturing partner focused on consistency, continuity and stable cooperation with leading brands
about.why_intro: Brands work with Fashion Comfort because we combine fast development, direct production control and a partnership mindset focused on consistency and reliability.
about.why_1_text: Dedicated sample facility with specialized knitting machines across multiple gauges
about.why_2_text: Our own factory, ASDWA Fashion Ltd., ensuring quality, consistency and reliable lead times
about.why_3_text: Certified, transparent and built for long-term collaboration
about.why_4_text: Teams in Barcelona, Prato and Tokyo working closely with our clients
about.why_5_text: Durability and performance as a core part of our sustainability approach
about.sample_text: Our sample home is a core part of our development process, designed to support fast decision-making and efficient product development.
about.sample_1_text: Dedicated sample building with machines covering multiple gauges and constructions
about.sample_2_text: Ability to develop multiple samples per day with lead times of up to 72 hours
about.sample_4_text: Yarn experimentation and material innovation built into the development workflow
about.sample_5_text: From initial concept to production-ready specifications in one integrated process
about.sample_6_text: Close partnership with clients' design and product teams throughout development
about.teams_heading: Design, development and sourcing — connected globally
about.teams_text: Our international teams work as an extension of our clients' design and product departments — combining local expertise with global production capabilities.
about.teams_closer_text: Direct access to clients' design teams in their local markets
about.teams_faster_text: Reduced lead times through regional coordination and oversight
about.teams_yarn_text: Direct access to Italian yarn markets and Asian supplier networks
about.teams_alignment_text: Better translation from creative intent to manufactured product
about.production_heading: Production with control, not just capacity
about.production_text_1: We operate our own production facility in Bangladesh, ASDWA Fashion Ltd., at the core of our manufacturing operations.
about.production_text_2: This structure allows us to maintain direct control over quality, processes and production standards at every stage — from development to bulk production.

work.description: Each piece reflects real production — not concept development.

manufacturing.hero_sub: Our production facility, ASDWA Fashion Ltd., is at the core of our operations.
manufacturing.hero_text: This allows us to maintain direct control over quality, processes and delivery at every stage — from development to bulk production.
manufacturing.overview_text: We operate a fully integrated knitwear manufacturing facility in Bangladesh, combining modern machinery, experienced teams and structured workflows. Our setup is designed to ensure consistency, scalability and reliable lead times across all programs.
